Title: Self-hosted IR sharing across multiple data factories

Body.Content:
You can share an existing self-hosted integration runtime (IR) with multiple data factories. This functionality helps you reuse an existing self-hosted IR infrastructure in another data factory while building a hybrid data-integration pipeline.

For more information, see the blog post.
